title: Redis, Background Jobs, and Reliability
description: Add caching, durable asynchronous work, resilient integrations, performance evidence, and repeatable quality gates without unnecessary distributed-systems ceremony.
learningOutcomes: Use Redis deliberately for caching, coordination, and bounded ephemeral state
Design durable jobs with idempotency, retries, outbox delivery, and observable failure handling
Protect outbound calls with explicit timeouts, concurrency limits, and recovery policies
Measure performance and enforce local and CI quality gates before release

lessons.title: Redis Mental Model and Key Design
lessons.description: Choose data structures, lifetimes, and keys from access patterns.

lessons.title: Caching Patterns and Invalidation
lessons.description: Use cache-aside safely and know when caching is the wrong fix.

lessons.title: Durable Jobs and Workers
lessons.description: Move critical asynchronous work out of request processes.

lessons.title: Idempotency, Retries, and the Outbox Pattern
lessons.description: Make repeated requests and deliveries safe under failure.
learningObjectives: Apply bounded retries and outbox delivery

lessons.title: Resilient Outbound HTTP
lessons.description: Use timeouts, limits, retry budgets, and circuit-breaking concepts.

lessons.title: Profiling, Load Testing, and Backpressure
lessons.description: Measure bottlenecks and keep overload bounded.

lessons.title: CI Quality Gates and Supply-Chain Hygiene
lessons.description: Make validation reproducible without performing deployment.

assignment.title: Assignment: Reliable Task Notifications
assignment.description: Add cached reads and durable task-notification jobs with failure and performance evidence.
